mapper.select: select ifnull(declare_status, '0') as k, count(*) as cnt from br_material where del_flag = '0' group by ifnull(declare_status, '0')
select ifnull(order_status, '01') as k, count(*) as cnt from br_work_order where del_flag = '0' group by ifnull(order_status, '01')

select 'IN' as docType, doc_status as k, count(*) as cnt, sum(case when date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayCnt from br_inbound group by doc_status union all select 'OUT' as docType, doc_status as k, count(*) as cnt, sum(case when date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayCnt from br_outbound group by doc_status union all select 'ISSUE' as docType, doc_status as k, count(*) as cnt, sum(case when date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayCnt from br_issue group by doc_status union all select 'RCV' as docType, doc_status as k, count(*) as cnt, sum(case when date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayCnt from br_receive group by doc_status
select ifnull(result_status, 'PENDING') as k, count(*) as cnt from br_declare_log group by ifnull(result_status, 'PENDING')

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as d, sum(case when biz_type = 'IN' then qty else 0 end) as inQty, sum(case when biz_type = 'OUT' then abs(qty) else 0 end) as outQty from br_stock_ledger where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
select biz_type as bizType, ifnull(result_status, 'PENDING') as resultStatus, msg, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as createTime from br_declare_log order by id desc limit #{limit}
